description: Named person, date, scope, artifact reference. Produced by the fit-to-standard skill; checked by the explore→realize Q-gate.

decision_log_row_id_range.description: Row ID range from the fit-to-standard decision log, e.g. FTS-2026-08-04-credit-block-handling-row-01..07. Source of truth for scope; wins over the prose description if they ever disagree.

process_scope.description: Human-readable label for the row range (process name, variant) — not an independent scope definition.

signed_by.description: Full name and title of the signer. Distinct from the decision log's per-row Delta owner, even when it's the same person.

role_authority.description: Why this person can accept — e.g. 'Process Owner, Order to Cash'.

deltas_accepted.description: Row IDs accepted in this scope.

deltas_rejected.description: Row IDs where standard was adopted instead of the proposed delta. An empty array on a large process is a signal to re-check whether pushback actually happened.

open_items_deferred.description: Open questions moved to the backlog rather than left as Workaround rows.

superseded_records.description: Prior sign-off-record references this one replaces for the same scope, if any.
